# Exposure ledger

Every model or tool touch (including a single-sample smoke) gets a row **before results are read**.
Exposure claims elsewhere must carry four fields: scope, date, counts, inherited exposure.

Field semantics (consolidated contract §6/§7; umbrella continuations 92/93):

- `execution profile` — one of `model-free-check` / `baseline-reproduction` /
  `bounded-discovery-probe`; paper-scale profiles never appear in this ledger.
- `split role` — `discovery` or `dev`. `confirmatory` rows require Stage-3 paper authority
  (`OWNER_GO_AND_PAPER_EXECUTION_CONTRACT`) or a dated owner allowance and do not occur in Stage-2.
- `split identity hash` — SHA-256 over the exact sample-identity list this touch may read.
- `consumed` — `yes` only when confirmatory results were read; **irreversible once `yes`**;
  model-free and discovery/dev rows write `no`.
- `inherited exposure` — scoped statement of prior exposure carried into this touch;
  monotonically non-decreasing across rows.
- `calls` / `speech audio seconds` / `gpu hours` — the registered budget record for this
  run; every cell must be a **finite non-negative number** (the gate refuses NaN or
  negative cells outright — they would corrupt the arithmetic). These columns carry no
  numeric ceiling of their own (the first-slice caps that used to sum them as slice
  totals — consolidated contract §6 — were retired by the 2026-08-06 owner amendment,
  `SAEA-OWNER-AMENDMENT-2026-08-06-BUDGET-CAPS`): `contracts.FrozenCoreGate` no longer sums
  these columns across rows. What it still enforces, per row, is the cross-check that a
  plan may only claim what its OWN matched row registers: `registered ≥ planned` for each
  of the three columns, against the plan's own declared `planned_model_calls` /
  `planned_speech_audio_seconds` / `planned_gpu_hours`.

Inherited exposure baseline: program-level prior exposure (W1 probe campaigns on other carriers; no
Earnings21/Earnings22/ConEC model exposure inherited as of 2026-08-03). The carriers' only
processing so far is model-free acquisition/verification (D0).

**2026-08-09 second amendment to the SAEA-E-002 rows (before any result is read).** The first launch of the `nocontext` arm ABORTED at slice 575/610 (attempt `attempt-20260809T090531Z-96ccb8`, 577 calls / 34,452 audio-s metered): the llama-server lost its CUDA context mid-run (process alive, 0 MiB GPU) and every later request hung to the 900 s transport ceiling; the bounded per-slice retry fired and also hit the dead server, so the attempt failed closed as designed. Cause: VRAM headroom — `-c 32768 -np 4` reserved 8k KV per slot against slices that need ~1.5k, leaving ~500 MB free on a 24 GB card. Fix attempt 1 (protocol-bound, new config hash): `-c 16384` (4k/slot). **That fix was itself WRONG and was stopped after 81 calls / 4,860 audio-s (attempt `attempt-20260809T112222Z-30ca91`, left OPENED when the operator killed it deliberately, before any result was read).** Reason for stopping: measurement showed the ConEC evidence materials the matched/mismatched arms inject run to 23.3 KB (~5,835 tokens; median 7.4 KB ≈ 1,850), so a worst-case evidence request needs ≈7,000 tokens — more than the 4,096/slot that `-c 16384 -np 4` provides. Letting it run would have completed the no-evidence arm and then failed the two evidence arms, invalidating the whole paired set (all three arms must share one config hash). A systematic memory strategy is being measured instead (KV quantization, CPU-RAM KV fallback using the 43 GB of idle system memory, partial layer offload, and a stable-prefix prompt ordering so a call's evidence block is prompt-cached once rather than re-sent per slice); all three arms then re-run together under one new hash. Both aborted/stopped attempts' spend stays on record here. **2026-08-09 third stop (before any result read): the first final-config attempt of the `nocontext` arm was killed at 86/610 slices after a 7.3× throughput collapse — first quarter 9.9 s/slice, last quarter 72.1 s/slice.** Cause: an ops agent's diagnostic process took a ~715 MiB CUDA context beside the run (it had assumed `-dev none` prevents a context; it does not), squeezing free VRAM to ~350 MiB; with `-ngl 999` disabling llama.cpp's device-memory fitting, allocations spill to host memory under pressure and are never migrated back, so throughput stayed degraded for 12+ minutes after the competing process died. Scientifically the outputs are unaffected (memory placement does not change arithmetic), but at 72 s/slice the three arms would have taken 30+ h instead of ~5 h, so the sequence was restarted on a verified-empty GPU (0 MiB, 0 compute apps). Standing rule adopted: **no process that can open a CUDA context may run beside a live experiment, diagnostics included.** **2026-08-09 fourth stop — a PROTOCOL DEFECT, not an environment one (before any result read):** the clean-GPU rerun of `nocontext` aborted at 581/610 with the same `[100054] asr … timed out`, and the earlier attempt aborted at 577 — a deterministic failure at ~578±3 on a specific input, with all 579 preceding slices healthy (15–16 s each, the last one 3.9 s). Root cause: **the model config declared no generation cap**, so a degenerate slice (silence/music/applause at a call's tail) can run away and generate until the 12,288-token slot fills — ≈600 s at ~20 tok/s — which exceeds even the 900 s transport ceiling, so the bounded per-slice retry could not help either (the retry would burn another 900 s the same way). Fix, protocol-bound and therefore a new config hash: `max_tokens: 1024` in `decoding_params` (≈4–5× the observed 146–250-token slice output, so legitimate transcripts are untouched) and `timeout_seconds` 900 → 240 (≈15× a healthy 16 s slice), which makes a runaway cost ~50 s and lets the retry actually recover. All three arms restart together under the new hash; every aborted attempt's spend stays on record above. **2026-08-09 correction to the fourth-stop diagnosis (recorded before the rerun's results are read).** Log forensics on `attempt-20260809T171603Z-1c09ee` confirmed part of the account above and falsified part of it. Confirmed: exactly one asr invocation never returned (580 `ability_start` events against 579 `ability_end`), and the arm aborted the instant that invocation's retry budget was exhausted. Wrong: it is **not** "a deterministic failure at ~578±3 on a specific input". The two aborted attempts hung on *different* samples (`4366429` in `96ccb8`, `4387383` in `1c09ee` — each attempt wrote 9 of the 10 per-sample derivation files, missing exactly the sample that hung), and the slice ordinal is incidental because `obs_batch_samples: 4` runs four samples concurrently. Nor was anything degrading: across all 580 requests the longest start→end gap was 38.6 s, and the run spanned 1.87 h, not the ~9 h a naive reading of the call count suggests. The fix stands and its rationale is strengthened: with no `max_tokens`, llama.cpp decodes until the slot's 12,288-token context fills, and because decoding is deterministic (temperature 0, fixed seed) the single bounded retry re-sent a byte-identical request and hung identically — **a bounded retry can only recover *transient* failures, never content-deterministic ones**, so capping generation is what actually makes the worst case finite. Consequence for reading the rerun: a slice whose completion is exactly 1024 tokens is a saturation flag rather than a transcript, and must be counted and reported, not scored silently.

The first chained R4 launch was REFUSED by contracts.gate_exposure on exactly this mismatch, before any model touch). Budget cells raised to the same 2000 / 150000 / 30.0 envelope as SAEA-E-001 to cover slice-level metering; the pre-registered success criterion is unchanged.

**2026-08-10 serving-throughput probe (pre-registered BEFORE any result is read).** Owner-directed infrastructure measurement, not an experiment: no scientific claim is derived from it, no split is scored, and no transcript is read. The first persisted llama-server log (`SAEA-E-002-r4-matched` attempt `72179f`) shows generation at **3.07–4.40 tokens/s per slot, ≈16 tokens/s aggregate**, against 470 tokens/s prefill — a prefill:decode ratio near 138:1 where 10–30:1 is normal, on a 3B-active MoE at Q4_K_M. The same log shows llama.cpp refusing to size the model to the device: `common_fit_params: failed to fit params to free device memory: n_gpu_layers already set by user to 999, abort`, with 23,406 of 24,462 MiB resident (95.7 %) and the server's own prompt cache climbing past 1,559 MiB against an 8,192 MiB limit. Hypothesis under test (owner's): decode is memory-bandwidth-bound, so any spill of weights or KV to host memory collapses it — the same mechanism already recorded here on 2026-08-09, when one competing 715 MiB CUDA context cost 7.3× and did not recover. **Probe:** four serving configurations — (A) current `-c 49152 -np 4 -fa on -ngl 999 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0`; (B) A with `--no-mmproj-offload`, which returns the mmproj's 2,940 MiB worst case to host memory; (C) f16 KV at `-c 32768`; (D) B+C combined — each serving a handful of identical requests built from ONE already-derived discovery slice (`derived/obs-slices/…/4330115/i0000.wav`), measured on the server's own reported prefill/decode timings. Discovery split only; no confirmatory identity is touched; the probe reads throughput numbers and VRAM, never transcript quality. **The R4 sequence was deliberately stopped mid-`matched` to free the GPU for this**, so that arm's partial spend stands on record and all three arms re-run afterwards under whichever configuration wins — serving args are inside the config hash, so this necessarily invalidates the already-completed `nocontext` attempt for pairing purposes and it re-runs too.

**2026-08-11 SAEA-BENCH-featcache correction (before any score was read).** The first COLD attempt was deliberately stopped at 52 slices and is INVALID: the pre-registered "cold run must show no hits" reading caught **382 false cache hits** — `mtmd_input_chunk_get_id` returns the BITMAP-level hash, shared by every ~104-token chunk cut from one audio buffer (~7.4 chunks per 60 s slice), so after the first chunk back-filled, every later chunk of the same slice "hit" and was injected with the FIRST chunk's features. The poisoned cache directory was purged; the key now includes the chunk's prompt position (patched build `862effd0f`, receipt regenerated, diff refreshed at docs/patches/2026-08-11-mtmd-feature-cache.diff; reuse contract unchanged for identical prompts — cold/warm, same-arm repeats — and cross-arm position drift deliberately misses, media-ordinal refinement deferred). The aborted attempt's spend (~52 calls / ~3,100 audio-s) stands on the row; the cold/warm pair restarts under the fixed build.

**2026-08-11 SAEA-BENCH-featcache cold/warm read-out — benefit NOT yet realized; both causes located (results read; `consumed` stays `no`).** COLD attempt `2afd8f` COMPLETED: 19.4 min / 102 calls / WER 0.2310 / **0 hits** (key fix verified) / 806 features back-filled — and vs the unpatched fixedwindow reference (2a0d08: 20.0 min / 0.2316) the patch's cold overhead is ~zero. WARM attempt `0b7e9f` COMPLETED: **20.1 min (no wall gain), 483 hits / 323 encodes (60% hit rate), WER 0.2461, transcripts not byte-identical to cold.** Causes, read directly from the numbers: (1) **position-keyed cache entries break under tail-length drift** — the rolling tail's token count varies with transcript noise across runs, shifting every audio chunk's prompt position (fixed windows removed the AUDIO cascade; the tail still carries a TEXT cascade) — fix: key by media ordinal within the bitmap, invariant to text prefix length; (2) **the 9p mount tax** — features on /mnt/e cost ~per-hit reads that roughly cancel the encode savings — fix: cache dir moves to ext4 (mlruns precedent for performance-critical local state). Honest revision on record: the recoverable ceiling on this arm is 10–29% of wall, pending clean next-round data on how serial encode truly is under 4-way batching. Verdict: NOT lockable; one fix round (ordinal keys + ext4 dir, new build/receipt/config hash) re-runs the pair. Spend added: ~204 calls / ~12.1k audio-s across the two attempts (plus the earlier invalidated 52-call cold).

**2026-08-12 SAEA-BENCH-featcache FORENSICS CLOSED — the collision was one off-by-one (no model touch; log + source forensics only).** Round-3's structure, read from the cold log: each 60 s slice is EIGHT ~104-token media chunks; per request exactly 5 encodes + 3 false hits at the even ordinals. Root cause, verified against source: `find_next_media_chunk` is `upper_bound` (STRICTLY greater), and the ordinal scan advanced by `start + n_tokens` — landing exactly ON the next chunk's start and skipping it, so even ordinals collapsed onto the preceding odd ones and o2/o4/o6 were injected with o1/o3/o5's features (~26 s of each slice heard the wrong audio → WER 0.57). Round-1's ~7.4 false hits/slice (bitmap-only keys, 8 chunks one key) closes under the same model. **Fix build `5d9dfcb58`** (receipt updated in this commit): the one-line advance fix plus a VALIDATE mode (`LLAMA_MTMD_FEAT_CACHE_VALIDATE=1`, fragment q4km-featcache-validate): the hit short-circuit is disabled, everything encodes, and every re-encountered key is byte-compared against the cache — a mismatch logs loudly and is overwritten with encoder truth. **Endgame trio pre-registered under this row:** VALIDATE-1 (populate + intra-run self-check), VALIDATE-2 (full-coverage compare; **806/806 MATCH and 0 MISMATCH is the constructive proof that the cache serves correct features — the owner's "WER 对齐" question answered by construction**), then a clean warm (validation off, full hits) whose wall against the cold reference is **the measured efficiency gain under correct supply — the owner's question 2**. WER of every run is additionally judged against the fixedwindow reference 0.2316/0.2310.

**2026-08-12 SAEA-E-002 R4 n=10 read-out — the paired criterion is NOT met, and the negative control earned its keep (results read; discovery rows stay `consumed=no`; analysis JSON at docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/r4-context-dose-comparison.json).** All three arms COMPLETED+FINALIZED under locked A′ in one sequence (613/608/611 calls; saturated-and-quarantined 2/2/5). Corpus WER: nocontext **27.12%**, matched **24.36%**, mismatched **24.60%** (macro 25.93/24.21/24.54). Pre-registered contrasts (exact Wilcoxon two-sided + 10k-resample bootstrap, seed 20260807): matched−nocontext mean **−1.7 pp**, CI95 [−4.5, +1.0], p=0.375 — direction holds, not significant; **matched−mismatched −0.33 pp, CI [−1.2, +0.5], p=0.557 — NO separation from the negative control**; mismatched−nocontext −1.4 pp, CI crosses zero. **Verdict: the success criterion (matched < nocontext AND matched < mismatched) FAILS on its second leg. The ~1.5 pp benefit of a context block is CONTENT-INDEPENDENT at this dose/form — deranged other-call ConEC lists help as much as the right call's lists.** This is the outcome the design's own caveat anticipated (ConEC materials are unigram frequency bags, and a deranged bag still carries generic earnings-domain vocabulary): the measured value is DOMAIN PRIMING, not call-specific facts. Steers, recorded: (i) E-003/B-2a's form contrasts gain priority (does form unlock call-specific value?); (ii) the self-supplied glossary path (L3) sharpens — if generic domain text is worth ~1.5 pp, a call's OWN accumulating vocabulary may be worth more at zero leakage; (iii) any claim about "evidence quality" on this carrier must first beat the domain-priming floor the mismatched arm now defines. Spend: 1,832 calls / 109,233 audio-s / ~7.5 gpu-h across the three rows this pass.

Two structural readings drawn from it. (i) **The primary null is a WASH, not stillness**: FS-BAL and FS-NONE tie at 49 but agree on only 54 of 60 labels, differing on 6 with an exact **3 gains / 3 losses** split (gains `005025` music->iot, `008047` lists->calendar, `009518` news->play; losses `000943` datetime->qa, `009733` play->general, `012478` transport->takeaway); balanced demos move 10 percent of the population and move it in both directions equally, acting as a RE-RANDOMIZATION of borderline decisions rather than as information about the label space (all three arms identical on 51/60). (ii) **The residual error is one confusable cluster, not diffuse noise**: `play` accounts for **6 of the 11** zero-demo errors and collapses into its media neighbours (3 -> `music`, 2 -> `audio`, 1 -> `news`), scoring 1/7 on FS-NONE, 1/7 on FS-BAL and 0/7 on FS-SKEW, while **9 of the 18 canonical classes are perfect on all three arms**; more than half the available headroom therefore sits in a single systematic confusion that generic demonstrations provably cannot address, which is the concrete reason the +0.10 gain was never in reach. **UNREGISTERED DESCRIPTIVE, NO CLAUSE ATTACHED -- IN-SESSION REPLICATION DISCREPANCY**: the in-session FS-NONE comparator reads **49/60 = 0.8167** where the cited consumed A1'r phase-1 read **47/60 = 0.7833** on the SAME 60 samples, with a pre-flight-verified BYTE-IDENTICAL prompt block (`pslu-s2-a1r-phase1-closed-set-v1`, 432 chars), the same decode config (`-c 49152 -np 4 -fa on -ngl 999 -ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0`; temperature 0, seed 20260803, max_tokens 1024), the same split identity hash and the same runtime build and GGUF hashes. Composition arithmetic, recorded because it is the only form such a router could be deployed in: as a REPLACEMENT it loses **214 of 400**; as a rescue/argmax-fallback applied only where decode fails it adds **2**; as a confidence-gated fallback it would need a gate that this space does not provide. No composition is net-positive on this carrier. **CONFUSION STRUCTURE -- THE SAME COLLAPSE AS RUN A, ON A 152-WAY PROBLEM**: only **15 of 152** tools were ever predicted, `stopCharging` alone taking **151/400 = 37.8 percent**, the top two **213/400 = 53.3 percent** and the top five **343/400 = 85.8 percent**; **137 registry rows were never the nearest neighbour of any clip**. On the 183 there are 11 distinct predictions (`stopCharging` 62, `setHumidifierState` 33, `streamCamera` 25, `getNetworkHealth` 24, `setHvacMode` 15) and on the 217 there are 13 (`stopCharging` 89, `getNetworkHealth` 33, `setHumidifierState` 29, `setHvacMode` 20, `setVoiceGuidance` 15). The table reads column-wise with no visible relation between gold tool and absorbing attractor -- `setColor->stopCharging` 4, `getAirQuality->stopCharging` 3, `getAirQuality_diag->streamCamera` 3, `setColor->setHumidifierState` 3, `setGroupLightState->streamCamera` 3, `setLighting->stopCharging` 3. **EVERY ONE OF THE 400 WINNING COSINES IS NEGATIVE**: max **-0.0494**, mean **-0.1253**, median **-0.1177**, min **-0.2541**, and **0/400** positive. With L2-normalized vectors on both sides, the BEST of 152 candidate rows is ANTI-ALIGNED with the audio on every single sample; Run A's near-orthogonality (mean +0.038) becomes uniform anti-alignment here, and the argmax is selecting the least-negative of 152 negative similarities -- a text-side geometry artifact, of which the 15-tool collapse is the same fact seen from the label side. **THIS CARRIER REMOVES RUN A's STRONGEST CONFOUND**: Run A's text side was a bare one-or-two-token canonical label and "severe length/form asymmetry against a multi-second clip" was a live explanation; Run B's text side is the FULL SHIPPED REGISTRY ROW (`data.audio2tool.render_registry_row`, `strip_defaults=False` -- name, description, parameter schema), an order of magnitude richer and longer, against clips averaging 5.4 s -- and the result is WORSE, not better (accuracy at chance, top-5 below chance, every cosine negative). Making the text side richer does not help, so length/form asymmetry is NOT the explanation and the surviving one is the one Run A named but could not isolate: **the frozen core has no contrastive objective, so its mean-pooled audio states and mean-pooled text states do not occupy a shared space.** Two carriers, two candidate-set sizes (18 vs 152), two text renderings, one conclusion. **P-TARGET DESIGN-GATE READING** (scoreboard design-queue item 3, registered as needing the P-EMB reads; both are now in): the gate resolves NEGATIVELY for the embedding channel and leaves the problem's importance unchanged. (1) **The embedding channel cannot supply the confidence signal** -- P-TARGET's implicit candidate was cosine margin, and a margin computed over a collapsed, anti-aligned similarity field ranks the attractor geometry rather than the samples' routing difficulty; measured on two carriers, not a marginal call. (2) **The targeting problem is unchanged and still binding** -- V4 measured the gap between targeted supply (+8 to +10 EM conversions on the gold-identified 120-id headroom set) and blind supply (-26 to -28 EM samples over the 217 ids where the rule is defined) at **34 to 38 EM samples wide**, an ORG/SUPPLY-side selection problem and not a supply-form problem; P-EMB-2 was the one registered instrument that could have changed the shape of that account by opening the excluded 183, and it did not, so the 45.75-percent-undefined denominator disclosure stays attached and the gap gains no new instrument from this arc. (3) **Where the signal must come from instead** -- the decode path, for which this arc has already produced measured gold-free candidates: label-token logprobs under the closed-set prompt (no extra call cost), and cross-prompt disagreement, whose statistics P-FEW happens to supply -- flagging the samples where FS-NONE and FS-BAL choose different labels marks **6 of 60**, on all 6 at least one arm is wrong, FS-NONE itself is wrong on **3 of the 6** for a flag precision of **0.50** against a base error rate of **11/60 = 0.1833**, a **2.73x lift** at recall **3/11 = 0.27**; three-way disagreement across FS-NONE/FS-BAL/FS-SKEW marks 9 at precision 0.33 (1.82x lift, same recall), so TWO arms are the better flag than three. Those figures are descriptive, unregistered, n=6 and carry no clause; they are recorded because they are the only measured gold-free targeting signal this program currently has. **RECOMMENDATION INPUT for a P-TARGET registration (an input, not a design, and not an authorization)**: register the confidence signal as a DECODE-PATH disagreement or logprob statistic; pre-register its precision/recall against the MEASURED base error rate rather than an assumed one; and scope the target population to the ids where an EM-signed rule is defined, EXPLICITLY EXCLUDING the 183, which this read has now shown are not reachable by the embedding route either. Any design assuming an embedding-derived confidence score is refuted before it starts. **SYNTHESIS -- ROUTING-TIER SCORECARD** (full version in the verdict document's appendix): closed-set decode routing (CITED A1'r 0.7833 = 47/60 plus in-session FS-NONE 0.8167 = 49/60, a **0.78-0.82 range across two sessions**, `{exact: 60}` mapping and 60/60 non-fallback under three prompt constructions) remains ESTABLISHED and, after this arc, is still the ONLY routing lever that works at all; few-shot demonstration supply on that router gives **no gain** (FS-BAL 0.8167, delta +0.0000, CI [-0.0667, +0.0667]) with equivalence NOT certified, and its skew arm shows a small real ICL-noise cost (+0.0667, CI [+0.0167, +0.1167]) with **zero** label-prior capture (0/59 incremental, marginal unchanged 3->3->3); bare mean-pooled embedding matching on SLURP is **below chance** (0.0500 vs 0.0556, 5 of 18 labels ever predicted, permutation P=0.8774); registry-row mean-pooled embedding matching on Audio2Tool is **at chance on top-1 and below chance on top-5 and on the 217** (0.0109 / 0.0273 / 0.0046, 15 of 152 tools, 400/400 negative cosines). Two candidate improvements, both eliminated cleanly. Two limits discovered inside the arc travel with every tier number: cross-session reproduction on the 60-sample SLURP routing instrument is **+/-2 samples (+/-0.0333)**, larger than the primary few-shot contrast and two-thirds of the +/-0.05 equivalence band; and the residual routing error is **structurally concentrated, not diffuse** (6 of 11 SLURP decode errors are `play` collapsing into `music`/`audio`/`news`, while 9 of 18 classes are perfect on every arm), which is the mechanical reason few-shot never had the headroom its +0.10 floor demanded. The arc's founding premise -- that the word-level acoustic resonance law does not extend to the label level -- is now evidenced at **2/2** (P-TRAP 0/32 cross-sample content capture; P-FEW 0/59 incremental label-prior capture). The tier's remaining untested idea is **corrective, targeted supply aimed at the measured confusion neighbourhood**, the routing-tier twin of the filling tier's supply-targeting problem and the natural object of a P-CORR-style design. **SCOPE**: descriptive, discovery-tier, n=400 Audio2Tool discovery split, 152 registry rows, ONE run, same-distribution, one carrier for this row and two across the appendix, one frozen core, ONE pooling mode (mean), ONE text rendering (full shipped registry row), no instruct prefix. The permutation checks, the composition arithmetic and the disagreement-flag statistics are descriptive and unregistered and carry no clause. The 183/217 partition is a property of ONE consumed A0 attempt (V4 bound 3), not an established stable set. The equivalence branch was equally live (32 paired samples can in principle put the whole CI inside +/-0.03), so neither branch was suppressed and no affirmative outcome is being reported on an unreachable clause. **VERDICT: ACOUSTIC-MEDIATED** (the section-6 CI-gated evaluator, authoritative; the registered section-3 point thresholds are met as well). capture(V1) = **29/32 = 0.9062**; capture(V2) = **0/32 = 0.0000**; rate difference **+0.9062** (0.90625); raw difference **+29**; sigma_hat = **0.0519** (0.051882) from the paired cluster bootstrap over the 32 common-denominator samples, N=10,000 replicates, seed 20260807; 90 percent CI **[+0.8125, +0.9688]**. CLAUSE MARGINS: ACOUSTIC-MEDIATED point (rate diff >= +0.10 AND raw diff >= 6) MET, clearing by **+0.8062** and **+23**; ACOUSTIC-MEDIATED CI-gated (point met AND CI low > 0) MET, CI low +0.8125 clearing the 0 gate by **+0.8125** with the entire CI above +0.81; KEY-ONLY-MATCHING point (abs(rate diff) <= 0.03) NOT MET, over by **+0.8762**; KEY-ONLY-MATCHING CI-gated NOT MET -- it failed on the point estimate before the CI was consulted, and the CI is disjoint from the equivalence band by +0.7825 at its nearest edge; INCONCLUSIVE-TRAP not reached. Every registered floor is cleared by roughly an order of magnitude; this is not a threshold artifact. **THE CONTROL RETURNED AN EXACT ZERO**: not one of the 32 cross-percept rows emitted its appended trap, across 49 flown V2 entries from 31 distinct donor samples. The capture detector is the SAME code path on both arms (same normalization, same exact-match test, same per-row trap list), so 29-vs-0 cannot be a detector asymmetry, and it is direct evidence that the core does not emit roster items opportunistically -- supplied wrong values with no acoustic relation to this audio are ignored completely. **PER-SAMPLE TABLE** (32 usable, full table in the verdict document and `verdict.json`): 29 captured on V1, 0 on V2; the three non-capturing usable samples are `000943`, `005453`, `007852`, ALL at K=1, the minimum dose. Unregistered descriptive with no clause attached, recorded because it is monotone -- capture by trap count: K=1 **15/18** (0.833), K=2 **11/11** (1.000), K=3 **3/3** (1.000): every sample offered two or more of its own mishearings took at least one. **K=0 STARVATION CAVEAT** (carried on every citation): 28 of 60 samples flew at K=0 and are outside the denominator -- only **5** because A0 emitted no wrong value at all (`000444`, `005536`, `005743`, `012667`, `017009`), and **23** because the fail-closed gold zero-overlap check removed EVERY candidate. In total that check dropped **42 of 91** harvested V1 candidates across **34** samples (11 of which retained at least one and are in the usable 32), plus 8 on V2, leaving 49 flown entries per arm. The check is correct and was enforced fail-closed three times at binding, but it is a SELECTION OPERATOR with a direction: a surviving V1 trap is a value the core produced from this audio that matches NO gold slot of this sample under any type -- a genuine misperception -- while a wiped-out sample is one whose A0 errors were all gold-adjacent (type misassignment or slot routing rather than mishearing). The usable 32 are therefore ENRICHED for genuine misperception and the excluded 23 are exactly the stratum where a self-percept trap would be least distinguishable from correct supply, so **0.9062 is an upper-leaning estimate of a population rate and must never be narrated as 'the core re-commits to its own mishearing 90 percent of the time on SLURP devel'**. The VERDICT nonetheless survives the most adverse available reweighting: assume zero V1 capture on all 28 excluded samples and score the whole 60 -> capture(V1) 29/60 = **0.4833**, capture(V2) 0/60 = 0.0000, rate diff **+0.4833** (clearing the +0.10 floor by +0.3833) and raw diff **+29** (clearing 6 by +23). Excluded samples can only lower V1 capture, never raise V2's exact zero, so no reweighting can flip the sign or the verdict; what the exclusion compromises is the MAGNITUDE, not the existence or direction of acoustic mediation. Secondary consequence: the trap supply is far sparser than the 91-value harvest implies and K tops out at 3 against a cap of 5, so the dose-response above is measured over a compressed range. **GUARDRAILS** (registered, descriptive, no clause attaches; cited comparator = the consumed P-SLU A3 arm's official pooled SLU-F1 0.5961280580450439, pinned as `CONSUMED_A3_SLU_F1` and taken verbatim from `2026-08-18-pslu-read/verdict.json`): SLU-F1 V1 **0.5003** (delta **-0.0958** vs A3) against V2 **0.5907** (delta **-0.0054**) -- trapping costs task quality and ONLY self-percept trapping does, which controls the roster-size confound outright since V2 appended exactly as many entries from the same source distribution at matched lengths. The arm-level figure is DILUTED: SLU-F1 is pooled over all 60 rows per arm and 28 of them carry no trap (identical plain A3-form requests on both arms), so the whole -0.0958 is generated by the 32 trapped samples and the cost where a trap exists is materially larger -- a subset SLU-F1 over the usable 32 was NOT computed by the registered suite and is NOT claimed. Induced substitutions V1 **11** / V2 **3**, and they localize precisely: 8 of V1's 11 fall on usable samples and 3 on excluded K=0 samples, while ALL 3 of V2's fall on those SAME three excluded ids (`005743`, `014263`, `015375`) whose V1 and V2 requests are identical constructions at K=0 -- an incidental in-read determinism check. Netting the shared baseline out, **the trap channel induced 8 substitutions on V1 and 0 on V2 over the same 32 samples**. Capture is not damage and the gap is informative: only 8 of the 29 captures registered an induced substitution, so **21 of 29 emitted the trap without displacing an aligned gold filler** -- self-percept contamination is UBIQUITOUS (90.6 percent of trapped samples) but SELECTIVELY COSTLY (28 percent of captures displace correct content). **INTEGRITY**: parse rate 1.0000 and empty rate 0.0000 on BOTH arms (no degenerate rows anywhere); `recheck_mismatch_count` **0** -- every per-sample TP/FP/FN reproduced the committed frozen scorer exactly on recheck; `harness_defect_reasons` EMPTY; flight status COMPLETED with error None; 60/60 rows on each arm across 120 distinct (arm, sample_id) pairs. **WHY THIS IS NOT THE 'IT WOULD HAVE SAID THAT ANYWAY' ARTIFACT**: with no supply the core scores 0.1741 SLU-F1 on these same 60 samples (P-SLU A0, reproduced bit-identically by P-KEY's AUD-NOSUP arm across sessions -- CITED, not recomputed here) and with the plain legal roster it scores 0.5961 (A3), so the roster MOVES THE CORE OFF most of its A0 percept; V1 re-supplies that abandoned percept in the roster's own item shape and the core TAKES IT BACK on 29 of 32 samples while losing ~0.096 pooled SLU-F1. The core does not merely persist in an error it was going to make -- it REVERSES a correction it had already made, when the error is re-presented as legal evidence. V2 independently rules out the roster-mechanics explanation (identical appended position, count, rendering, length distribution and source distribution; the ONLY difference is whether the value came from this sample's audio or another's; it captured zero). **WHAT THIS ADDS TO P-KEY'S INCONCLUSIVE ON THE SPEECH TERM**: P-TRAP does NOT fire P-KEY's clauses and cannot -- P-KEY's I is a NET TASK-QUALITY BENEFIT interaction on a partial-credit metric while P-TRAP's capture difference is a MECHANISM-PRESENCE measurement on the matching step; nothing here re-opens or re-cuts P-KEY's registered thresholds. What it changes is which explanations of P-KEY's null remain available: the deflationary account that **the audio is ONLY a retrieval key**, with all roster matching done text-side against the core's own transcript, is now FALSIFIED as a general description of matching -- if matching were text-side, a wrong value with no acoustic relation to this audio would be no less matchable than one with, and V2 captured 0/32 against V1's 29/32. The joint statement is therefore narrower than either probe alone: (i) the speech channel PARTICIPATES in supply USE (CI-gated, margin about 8x the floor) -- not a key, a live discriminator at match time; (ii) its measured NET contribution to task quality remains unresolved (P-KEY I = +0.0463, CI crossing zero, dead-zone point estimate) -- participation is not benefit; (iii) the one place that participation has been MEASURED rather than inferred, it is a COST (-0.0958 pooled SLU-F1, 8 induced substitutions vs V2's 0). The tension between a large mediation effect (+0.906) and a small uncertain benefit (+0.046) reconciles, as a READING and not a measurement, as: the acoustic percept is consulted at match time, but on this carrier the core's own transcript already carries nearly all the information that consultation uses (P-KEY: a 53.6-percent-macro-WER self-transcript costs -0.0001 at baseline and +0.046 under supply). **QUALIFICATION SECTION 2b stays OPEN and its freeze stays HELD** -- P-TRAP was never a section-2b decision instrument and does not become one. What 2b may now record as settled is a new line: the speech-term question has an AFFIRMATIVE MECHANISM-SIDE answer (matching is acoustically mediated, CI-gated, on the SLURP carrier) beside an UNRESOLVED BENEFIT-SIDE answer; the honest framing is no longer 'speech knowledge participates, or the audio is only a key' because the second disjunct is dead, but 'speech participation in USE is established; its net value in the supply loop is not'. **NEW USE-SIDE RISK, citable at discovery tier** beside C2's harm channel and C5's deployment reading: SELF-PERCEPT CONTAMINATION -- if a control plane's evidence roster can contain the core's own earlier outputs on the same audio (which any pipeline with a recall/caching/self-supply stage can produce by accident), the core re-commits at 0.9062 on the trapped population, reversing repairs the legal roster had already made, and displaces gold content on 28 percent of captures; the implied mitigation is an ORG-side provenance rule (never re-supply the core's own prior emissions for the same episode) and the V2 construction is the control that makes it checkable. **SCOPE**: descriptive, discovery-tier, n=60 SLURP devel of which 32 usable, single run, same-distribution, one carrier, an enriched trap stratum per the K=0 caveat; sigma_hat is measured on exactly one flight. 'Acoustically mediated' means matching is sensitive to the audio; it does NOT identify what about the audio (phonetic similarity, prosodic alignment, or coarse this-audio-vs-that-audio discrimination) and the design cannot distinguish those. NC CARRIED: SLURP audio CC BY-NC 4.0 on every audio-derived number. No test split was touched. No superiority, generalization, deployment, or paper-scale claim attaches. |

**Dataset analysis fixes the information requirements and the next cold engineering cell before model contact.** SLURP train contains 11,514 sentences, 50,628 real recordings, 18 scenarios, 91 fine-grained intents, 46 action values, 60 observed scenario--action pairs, and 55 entity types. At recording weight the scenario prior entropy is 3.944 bits; conditioning on action leaves 1.091 bits, and conditioning jointly on action plus the observed entity-type signature still leaves 0.611 bits. Therefore operation cues alone are information-incomplete: speech-conditioned target/object/context evidence remains necessary. The frozen knowledge artifacts cover all 18 scenario definitions and all 60 scenario--action pairs through 18 target plus 60 operation factors; every card has five train-only positive examples and a contrastive boundary. However, only 30 explicit graph boundaries cover 66 cross-scenario pairs sharing an action, leaving a legitimate knowledge/AgentLoop optimization surface rather than evidence that speech failed. **The next M11 prompt optimization is implemented model-free as a versioned policy, without adding a script or model contact.** Policy `speech-conditioned-adaptive-evidence-gap-v2` reuses the existing matcher and contact dispatcher while moving deterministic graph knowledge into the llama.cpp JSON grammar: one `oneOf` branch per candidate binds `key_id` to only that key's registered factors, and `prefixItems` requires the first factor to be an operation. The local pinned llama.cpp source at commit `04ccc72a2` implements both constructs. The v1 policy remains readable and reproducible; the existing experiment config now points prospectively to v2. This removes the observed cross-key/operation structural degree of freedom without adding an information-free retry. The reranking handler requires a string query, string documents, rank pooling, and a reranker-compatible model; it cannot accept the registered speech-feature packet and is not available from the current always-on Omni profile. Generated-token logprob and reranking therefore remain outside the M11 state and training-free action space. Reconsideration requires a receipt-pinnable speech-query-to-fixed-key conditional sequence score on the same decoder-only service, with no second model or profile replacement. Manager PID 612 / server PID 620 were not contacted, stopped, or modified.

Four further gates had to pass first and did: the flown retain-versus-dispatch decision is reproduced per sample (100 of 100, 100 of 100, 400 of 400, **497 of 500**) and the three NEW500 deviations are **exactly the three v2 delta-override fires** `002303`, `002955` and `014737` with zero unexplained, which is the expected consequence of replaying the LOCKED v1 cell against an arm that flew v2; the flown SUPPLY is reproduced exactly on every dispatched sample (37, 33, 130, **163**); the DEV-100 committed reports' own retain-primary and correct counts are reproduced (63 and 72, 67 and 72); and **every direct-decode text this gate tokenizes re-hashes to the `text_sha256` its own landed query-vector record carries, 1,100 of 1,100** - so the lexical channel's query side is byte-identical to the dense channel's, and no text can have been substituted for another. 9,900 vectorised cosines were cross-checked against `kb_policy._cosine` and all agreed to 1e-9.

**THE FALSIFIER, EVALUATED AS WRITTEN AND NOT REPAIRED AFTER THE ANSWER.** The agenda plan pre-registered 'if hybrid ranking does not raise recall at 5, key representation is not the lever either, and the residual is task-intrinsic'. On the primary unexposed 500 - the population the lock statistic used - recall at 5 rises from **0.744 to 0.762 under RRF at k=60 (+1.8 pp, +9 of 500)** with the raw direct-decode query text, and to 0.758 with the schema-key-stripped variant; on NEW400 it rises 0.715 to 0.735. **The antecedent is NOT met, so the falsifier's conclusion is NOT licensed: the key plane is not saturated, and a channel that has never been used reaches gold facets the dense channel misses, consistently across two disjoint held-out populations.**

**AND THE FLIGHT IS STILL REFUSED, on three quantities the falsifier did not name and this gate measured anyway.** (1) Every rule that raises recall at 5 COSTS recall at 1: the same RRF-60 takes the unexposed 500 from 0.636 to 0.590, minus 23 samples at the head of the list, and the z-normalised linear rules degrade monotonically in the lexical weight (recall at 1 falls to 0.384 at w=0.75). (2) The already-measured conversion anchors are steeply rank-dependent - 98.2 percent at fused top-1, 69.6 percent at fused rank 2 or 3, 0.0 percent absent - so demoting one gold from rank 1 costs 0.286 expected correct answers while promoting one from absent buys 0.696, and 23 demotions against 9 promotions does not close. (3) With the second dimension ACTUALLY ACTIVATED inside the registered `kb_policy` ranker and fuser at the frozen tau 0.65 / m 5 / c 2 / top_l 3, the supply newly carries gold on **12 currently-wrong trajectories and LOSES gold on 40 currently-correct ones** (12 against 29 under the stripped query; 11 against 21 and 9 against 13 on NEW400) - the loss side exceeds the gain side on every population under both query normalizations by a factor between 1.4 and 3.3. **The central conversion projection is NEGATIVE everywhere: minus 2.70 pp and minus 0.75 pp on the unexposed 500, minus 1.82 and minus 0.77 on NEW400, minus 1.83 and minus 1.49 on DEV-100 rounds 4 and 5.** No trajectory anywhere was priced at the unanchored rank-4-plus extrapolation, because the frozen top_l of 3 keeps every priced sample inside the measured anchor set.

**A REGISTERED DEFECT IN THE FALSIFIER'S OWN CONSTRUCTION, recorded rather than used as licence to reinterpret the result.** A single-sided recall test cannot see a cell whose top-1 conversion is 98.2 percent, where the head of the list is worth more than its tail. Any future key-plane falsifier on this cell must be two-sided - recall at 1 AND recall at 5, or the conversion-weighted quantity 0.982 times P(rank 1) plus 0.696 times P(rank 2-3) directly. Read against that objective every rule in the grid is a loss, which is the same verdict the projection reaches independently.

**THE STRUCTURAL RESULT THAT STANDS AND IS THE ONE DURABLE ASSET.** The plan's section 2.1 degeneracy is CONFIRMED on all 1,100 samples before it is repaired - `dims_total` 3, every facet carrying exactly one dimension, `agreement` the constant one third, the score the affine map 0.5 cos plus 0.0667. With the lexical dimension live, `dims_total` becomes 4, **`agreement` takes two distinct values (one quarter and one half) instead of one**, 293 of 2,500 top-m candidates on the unexposed 500 carry `dims_hit` equal to 2 (**11.7 percent**, rising to 13.5 percent under the stripped query and to 14.3 percent on NEW400), 181 to 217 of the 500 samples carry at least one two-dimension candidate, and **1,417 facets were percept-admitted by the lexical dimension ALONE** with a dense cosine below the tau bar. At the frozen `w_agree` of 0.2 the separation between a two-dimension and a one-dimension candidate at equal maximum signal is **0.05, equivalent to a plus 0.10 cosine bonus**. **The rank-weight family is structurally non-degenerate for the first time.** That is a true statement about the score's SHAPE and is independent of, and survives, the negative accuracy projection; it is explicitly NOT a claim that re-weighting now buys accuracy.

**COST NOTE, MEASURED NOT MODELLED, AND IT CORRECTS THE PLAN IN THE USEFUL DIRECTION.** The lexical channel is FREE: under the registered scoring form every per-document BM25 weight is query-independent, so the index over all 11,514 content-facet texts is built ONCE in **0.054 s** (5,219 terms, 78,402 postings, corpus sha256 `4b971c1a...3da1`) and a query is a gather plus a bincount costing **9.64e-5 s = 0.096 ms**, i.e. **0.096 s per 1,000 trajectories against the plan's 2,294 s per 1,000 reference - a factor of 4.2e-5**. The plan's engineering note reads 'any second dimension multiplies that 1.147 s'; it does not. The 1.147 s belongs to the EXISTING scalar cosine sweep in `kb_policy.multidim_recall`, and this module's vectorised equivalent measures **0.98 ms for the same 11,514-facet sweep - a roughly 1,170-fold speedup whose fidelity the 9,900-probe agreement check already proved**. Vectorisation is therefore NOT a prerequisite blocker for K1; it is a demonstrated small change worth landing on its own merits for the roughly 19 minutes of CPU per 1,000 trajectories it removes from every future campaign.

**WHICH TIER COULD EVALUATE IT, VERIFIED AGAINST THIS GATE'S OWN NUMBERS RATHER THAN ASSUMED.** Against the registered plus-or-minus 2 per 100 variance channel: DEV-100 sees a central effect of minus 1.8 samples against plus-or-minus 2 (**cannot resolve**, confirming the plan's statistical-honesty clause); NEW400 sees minus 7.3 against plus-or-minus 8 (**cannot resolve**); the unexposed 500 sees minus 13.5 against plus-or-minus 10 (**marginal at best**). The plan said 'NEW400-tier or larger'; **that is too generous, and the honest floor is at least 1,000 samples** - which, with a negative central sign, is not worth spending. Note the asymmetry in what carries variance: the retrieval numbers are exact arithmetic over sealed query vectors and carry no decode variance whatever, and only the projected accuracy does.

STAGE G1 IS STOPPED AT THE GATE, BEFORE ANY FLIGHT, BY THE RULE THIS ROW FIXED IN ADVANCE.** Row `SAEA-SN-MF-A2T-G1-PROMPT-FIT-NP8` (registered `11d2ec2d` BEFORE any contact), generator `scripts/a2t_g1_prompt_fit.py` (committed `545cfc27` before that), receipt `docs/checks/speech-aware-evidence-acquisition/2026-08-25-a2t-g1-prompt-fit/prompt-fit.json` sha256 `fd1edfa1d7fc6aa852775d368865237a24d3033f7c56f92e6ab7752d24ea69c6` with its README stating the outcome verbatim. **THE NUMBERS, EXACT FROM THE RESIDENT TOKENIZER, NOT ESTIMATED.** Envelope `m0-direct-decode` renders **13,236** text tokens; envelope `blend-evidence-decode-worst` renders **19,047**. Against the locked np8 profile's **8,192** tokens per slot (`-c 65536 -np 8`, verified live at preflight as `/health` ok with 8 of 8 slots idle) the margins are **-10,921** at the locked 64-token completion reserve, **-11,881** at the A2T-required 1,024-token reserve, and **-12,395** once a realistic 514-token speech allowance is added. Required context per slot **20,587** against **8,192** available: the requirement is **2.51 times the budget**. THE HEADLINE IS THE M0 ARM, NOT THE EVIDENCE ARM: M0 carries no evidence slot at all - it is the bare prompt-matched direct decode that produced the published A0 comparator - and it overruns a slot by **5,046 tokens while being credited with ZERO audio tokens and ZERO output reserve**. The BLEND overrun (10,857 on the same zero-credit basis) is a consequence, not the cause. The frozen registry is 50,291 characters and is counted exactly ONCE (`task_contract_counted_once` true), so no double-rendering inflates this.

**THE PRIMARY BOUND CREDITS ZERO SPEECH TOKENS ON PURPOSE, AND THAT IS WHY THE RESULT IS SAFE.** Audio2Tool has no promoted speech-feature packet root (the prior A2T flights encoded audio live through the mtmd feature cache `/home/chao/feat-cache/audio2tool-q4km`, 490 legacy `.feat` entries, no packets), so no packet could be measured without first flying a preprocessing pass. Zero is the strictly MOST GENEROUS assumption available and can only help the prompt fit, so a negative margin computed at zero speech tokens is a **LOWER BOUND on the deficit** and cannot be an artefact of the assumption. The 514-token secondary applies the landed np8 SLURP receipt's own measured rate (117 tokens at 8.126875 s, 78 at 5.312 s, about 14.4 tokens per audio second) to this carrier's longest item `tier7_multiturn:001590` at 35.714 s; it is a reference and was never the gate.

**THE CAUSE IS SERVING GEOMETRY, MEASURED RATHER THAN ASSUMED, AND THE COMPARATOR ALREADY KNEW IT.** llama-server divides `-c` across `--parallel` slots, so the locked profile yields 65,536 over 8 equals 8,192 per slot - a geometry sized for SLURP, whose ENTIRE BLEND evidence prompt measured **6,174 against that same 8,192 slot at margin +1,954**. Audio2Tool's BARE REGISTRY CONTRACT is larger than SLURP's whole evidence prompt: 13,236 against 6,174, a factor of **2.14**, on a task contract of 50,291 characters against 5,424, a factor of **9.3**. The registered A0 flight's own committed launcher records that it dropped its fragment's `-np 4` to `-np 1` - the whole 49,152-token context to one sequence - PRECISELY because `-np 4` would have given 12,288 per slot, 'BELOW this flight's own ~12.6k-token registry prefill'. **A0 could not fit its own prompt at 12,288 per slot; the locked profile offers 8,192.** A0's own estimate was additionally an UNDER-estimate: the exact count is 13,236, not the ~12,693 the binding config projected, because dense JSON punctuation tokenizes more finely than a chars-over-4 heuristic predicts.

**WHAT THIS IS NOT.** It is NOT evidence that the paradigm fails to transfer: nothing here touches retrieval, fusion, dispatch or decode, and the G0 reachability gate still stands at PASS (lexical ceiling at k=5 0.7925 against A0 tool accuracy 0.5425). The established finding is narrower and purely mechanical - **the locked cell's SERVING GEOMETRY, not its knobs, is physically incompatible with the Audio2Tool contract size, and the paradigm was never given the chance to run.** It is also NOT a licence to shrink, summarize, truncate or retrieve over the 152-row registry: that would move M0 away from the published A0 comparator and silently answer a different question, which the campaign plan section 4.3 forbids. NO KNOB WAS CHANGED and no file under `rails/` or `core/` was touched.

**THE PROJECTION, ARITHMETIC AND SINGLE-VARIABLE.** Per-slot context is `-c` divided by `-np`, so at the unchanged total 65,536 the whole fix is one integer. Requirements including the 514-token speech reference and the 1,024-token completion reserve are M0 14,776 and BLEND-worst 20,587. `-np 8` gives 8,192 and FAILS both (-6,584 and -12,395). `-np 4` gives 16,384 and passes M0 (+1,608) but still FAILS BLEND (-4,203). **`-np 3` gives 21,845 and is the MINIMUM that clears the worst envelope (+1,258); `-np 2` gives 32,768 and is the first setting with real headroom (+12,181)**, leaving total context, KV cache and VRAM unchanged so no memory re-measurement is needed, at a throughput cost of 2 concurrent slots instead of 8. THREE THINGS WOULD HAVE TO BE REGISTERED TOGETHER and none of them is a policy knob: (1) `-np 8` to 2 or 3, a SERVING-GEOMETRY change while alpha, tau, recall top-k, fusion m and c and top_l, rank weighting, prior source, boundary stage and percept admission all stay at the locked v1 cell; (2) `max_tokens` 64 to 1,024, forced by the output shape - a JSON call list, not a single short label - and already the registered A0 value on this carrier; (3) the A2T speech-feature packet root, which does not exist and must be materialized by a label-free preprocessing pass before any arm can fly against a `--no-mmproj` decoder. Whether (1) and (2) forfeit the plan's section 4.1 'transfers-unchanged' claim is an OWNER decision, not this row's: the honest framing available is that they are carrier-forced SERVING parameters rather than tuned knobs, but they are still changes and section 4.1 requires any A2T-specific change to be registered as such.

**SCOPE, BINDING.** This row measured a token bound and evaluated one gate. Per its own preregistered stopping rule the `SAEA-A2T-G1` campaign row was NOT registered, no preprocessing pass was flown, no canary was run and no arm was flown. It authorizes NO flight, NO campaign registration, NO knob change, NO generality claim and NO Stage-3 activity; a generality claim belongs to G2 on the unexposed tier and cannot be reached from anything measured here. **THE DEFECT, MEASURED ON BOTH CARRIERS.** The ranker forms `w_cos * max_cosine + w_prior * max_prior + w_agree * agreement` at 0.5 / 0.3 / 0.2. The agreement term is DEGENERATE on both carriers and cancels exactly - `dims_total` is 3 and every recalled facet carries exactly one dimension, 1,560 of 1,560 on A2T and 7,500 of 7,500 on SLURP - so ranking is decided by `0.5 * cosine` against `0.3 * prior` alone. No content facet ever carries prior mass on either carrier, so that comparison is ALWAYS a cosine against a mass, on two scales. **THE INVARIANT THE LOCKED CELL SILENTLY RELIED ON: every admissible content facet outranks every prior-mass facet if and only if `w_prior * sup(prior_score) < w_cos * tau`, i.e. `sup(prior_score) < 1.08333`.** MEASURED: SLURP sup is exactly **1.0000** (inside, margin **+0.0833**) because `rails.knowledge_build` divides an intent count by its own containing scenario count and the ratio is a genuine conditional probability; Audio2Tool sup is **4.1000** (outside by **3.78x**) because `rails.knowledge_build_a2t` divides a tool count taken across every (domain, category) by one category's count, and tool to (domain, category) is not a function on this corpus - the G0 report's own finding that `tool_id` is not a join key. All ten recalled A2T prior-mass facets carry a mass above 1.19, i.e. every one of them is outside the declared range.

**CEILING A - THE ALPHA VETO IS STRUCTURAL, AND THE BOUND IS ATTAINED RATHER THAN MERELY RESPECTED.** `_fused_label_scores` floors every raw label score at 0.0 before the max and then normalizes, so `fused` lies in `[0,1]` with `sum(fused)` in `{0,1}` BY CONSTRUCTION whatever the ranker returns; `_blend_scores` then gives the direct label `alpha*f + (1-alpha)` and every rival `alpha*f`, so the worst-case margin is `1 - 2*alpha` = **+0.10** at the frozen alpha 0.45 against the `_argmax_labels` tie tolerance of 1e-9. A recovered direct label is therefore the strict unique argmax for EVERY possible supply, and `retain == direct-label-recovered` is a property of the POLICY FORM rather than an empirical finding. THE DEFECT. `SAEA-SN-MF-STAGE2A-MATURED-SYNTHESIS` established from source that BOTH knowledge builders compute `prior_score` as a ratio whose numerator and denominator range over DIFFERENT populations: `rails/knowledge_build_a2t.py:1085-1087` divides a tool's row count taken over the WHOLE construction pool by one `(domain, category)`'s row count, and `rails/knowledge_build.py:696-698` divides an intent's globally-counted rows by a scenario's globally-counted rows. Neither restricts the numerator to the conditioning event, so neither is a conditional probability and neither has any reason to be <= 1; the A2T measured supremum is 4.1 with 193 of 12,601 values above 1, and SLURP is safe ONLY because `intent = f"{scenario}_{action}"` (line 202) makes an intent strictly determine its scenario. (1) It REPAIRS the computation in both builders so the numerator is restricted to the conditioning event - A2T `count(rows with this tool AND this (domain, category)) / count(rows in this (domain, category))`, SLURP `count(rows with this intent AND this scenario) / count(rows in this scenario)` - and renames every local whose name asserts a restriction the code did not perform. | 2026-08-25 | SAEA-SN-MF-FUSION-FORM-OFFLINE-GATE | model-free-check | THE FUSION-FORM OFFLINE GATE - a ZERO-CONTACT projection over ALREADY-SEALED records deciding whether the facet ranker's THREE-KINDS-IN-ONE-SUM scoring form is worth proposing as a change, computed before any line under `rails/`, `core/` or `configs/` is touched and computed WITHOUT touching one. THE QUESTION: `rails/kb_policy.py`'s registered ranker sums `w_cos * max_cosine + w_prior * max_prior + w_agree * agreement` into ONE score, and the three summands are quantities of DIFFERENT KINDS - a cosine is a similarity, `max_prior` is a probability mass, `agreement` is a coverage fraction. The field's standard practice is to keep one comparison on one bounded scale, and the literature's three canonical answers to incommensurability are (i) convert similarities to a distribution and interpolate it with a second distribution (kNN-LM, Tip-Adapter), (ii) normalize each list then combine, and (iii) fuse RANKS rather than scores (reciprocal-rank fusion). THE CANDIDATE CHANGE UNDER TEST: the facet ranking score becomes COSINE ONLY, and the prior moves to the layer where it is ALREADY a probability - `_fused_label_scores`, which normalizes to sum 1 and is then interpolated by `_blend_scores` - which is the kNN-LM / Tip-Adapter shape and which also removes the `agreement` term's established constant-one-third degeneracy. WHY THIS IS ASKABLE CLEANLY ONLY NOW: the prior-score semantics repair (`docs/readiness/2026-08-25-prior-score-semantics-repair.md`, commits `b3a420d7` / `ea77413c`) made `prior_score` a genuine conditional probability on BOTH carriers - corrected supremum exactly 1.0, priors summing to 1 over every conditioning cell - so the question is no longer confounded with that defect. WHAT IS COMPUTED, all of it arithmetic over sealed bytes, with the REAL `kb_policy.multidim_recall`, the REAL registered fuser, the REAL `_fused_label_scores` / `_blend_scores` / `_argmax_labels` imported so that ONLY THE SCORING DIFFERS between arms: (C0) the CONTROL, the live form exactly as landed, which must reproduce the flown decisions as a FAIL-CLOSED fidelity gate before any other arm's number is read; (C1) COSINE-ONLY facet ranking with tau, k, m, c and top_l unchanged, so the prior dimension no longer competes for the top-m window; (C2) C1 plus the prior as a LABEL PRIOR entering `_fused_label_scores` MULTIPLICATIVELY on the raw label score before normalization - the Bayes / Tip-Adapter frequency-weighted-cache shape, parameter-free, introducing NO new knob - with a secondary registered comparator C2B that instead INTERPOLATES the retrieval distribution against the prior distribution at a pre-registered lambda grid 0.10 / 0.25 / 0.50, the literal kNN-LM shape, reported as a comparator only because it introduces a knob that is not in the frozen table; and (C3) RRF ACROSS DIMENSIONS at K=60, the literature's third answer, carried as a comparator with the K1 gate's own measured result quoted beside it (RRF-60 raised gold-facet recall-at-5 0.744 to 0.762 while LOWERING recall-at-1 0.636 to 0.590 and was REFUSED for flight on exactly that basis). A form must not reduce the number of dispatched trajectories that receive a non-empty supply, and must not reduce the aggregate number of distinct supplied task_targets or the aggregate number of supplied values on the dispatched set.
